messages:
emma: FYI planning note: co-present with AcmeHW live webinar on 2025-04-06 10:00 PDT. Need speaker bios, demo fallback plan, and swag shipping cutoffs. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG (partners only).
lee: Confirmed speakers from AcmeHW: Lee (edge eng), Michael H. (product). Redwood confirmed: Emma, Simon, plus Simon will run the failover demo. Nora will MC.
simon: Demo kit shipped via FedEx 1Z999AA10123456789. ETA 2025-04-04. Manifest includes EB-889-AC-21.
jordan: Can we get an estimated live audience? Need stream settings and rehearsal slot.
nora: Targeting 200 live + YT stream. I'll own the YouTube stream and social. Need headshots + 1-paragraph bios by 2025-03-26.
emma: Run-of-show (tentative):
- 10:00 intro (5m)
- 10:05 roadmap & value props (5m)
- 10:10 live-coding: EdgeBox -> Redwood Dedicated (Lee) (20m)
- 10:30 failover: switch to hosted endpoint (Simon) (10m)
- 10:40 live Q&A (10m)
- 10:50 CTA + close (10m)
simon: Preflight script added to Drive (preflight.sh). I'll run 1 week prior and 24h prior. Also scheduling A/V dry-run on 2025-04-05 16:00 PDT.
lee: For hardware failover: plan A local EdgeBox; plan B Acme backup EdgeBox; plan C switch to hosted rdx-7b-quant in us-west-2. I'll provide the toggle script.
emma: Ops please confirm venue allows outbound TLS (443) to our endpoints and allow SSH from tech laptop.
simon: Contacted venue-net@conferencesvc.com. Will run network checks during dry-run.
jordan: RTMP/stream link? I need rehearsal invite.
nora: Stream preview created: https://studio.youtube.com/preview/def456. Shared RTMP key in Drive (permissions: partnerships@redwood.com, michael@acmehw.com).
emma: Swag update: Acme sending 50 mini power banks + stickers. Ops cutoff Apr 3 14:00 PST to avoid venue handling fees.
lee: Acme needs a 6' table and HDMI capture. I'll confirm with Michael.
simon: Added serial EB-889-AC-21 to inventory after delivery. All good.
nora: MC fallback scripts added (light tone + technical fallback) in /scripts/mc_fallback.txt.
jordan: Need a canned Slack/Email template for post-event follow-ups and lead capture. Nora, can you draft?
nora: Drafted and dropped into Drive under /assets/post_event_template.md.
emma: Outstanding actions: bios due 2025-03-26 (ALL), Simon to validate preflight + serial (SIMON), Jordan to run A/V dry-run (JORDAN), Nora to finalize marketing assets (NORA), Lee to confirm on-site contact & table (LEE).
events-bot: Reminder: A/V dry-run scheduled 2025-04-05 16:00 PDT.
lee: I'll ping Michael to confirm arrival and onsite setup window.
simon: If local demo stalls, we'll run recorded demo + switch to hosted endpoint. Toggle command tested: `POST /v1/switch-demo {"target":"hosted","model":"rdx-7b-quant"}`. I added automatic retry to runbook.
emma: Thanks team. If anything blocks, drop here or DM. :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
